title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
title_en: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs

inline_images.caption: What’s really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga
inline_images.alt: What’s really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga

author: The Verge AI
content_snippet:
Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life.

Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is perhaps best known for having served on the board of OpenAI, when she was one of four board members who voted to fire Sam Altman. That incident, now sometimes referred to as “the blip,” ended with Sam coming back as CEO,
summary_en: Helen Toner, Executive Director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University and a former OpenAI board member, stated that accountability mechanisms in AI frontier labs are structurally flawed when confronted with commercial incentives. She argues that relying on individual leadership integrity and voluntary safety accords is insufficient to guarantee safety in large-scale model development.
title_zh: OpenAI前董事对AI行业监管架构的深刻质疑
summary_zh: OpenAI前董事Helen Toner指出，现有的AI行业治理与问责机制无法有效制衡商业扩张与安全投入的利益冲突

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心（CSET）执行主任、OpenAI前董事会成员Helen Toner公开表示，AI领军企业的问责机制存在结构性失灵，企业使命在商业利益压力下极易发生偏移。她认为，依赖单一CEO的个人道德判断与自愿性合规协议，难以从根本上保障大模型开发的安全性与社会责任。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Helen Toner, Executive Director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University and a former OpenAI board member, stated that accountability mechanisms in AI frontier labs are structurally flawed when confronted with commercial incentives. She argues that relying on individual leadership integrity and voluntary safety accords is insufficient to guarantee safety in large-scale model development.

title_en: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
author: Matt Burgess and Lily Hay Newman
content_snippet: It is difficult to determine exact numbers of ransomware attacks, given that victims don’t always disclose incidents and attackers wildly inflate their claims. But researchers who specialize in tracking and attempting to de-duplicate the field agree that claimed incidents have spiked over the last few months. Some put the number of alleged ransomware attacks on leak sites—where groups post alleged victims—at nearly 3,000 attacks over the summer. This would mean a 20 to 40 percent increase since
summary_en: Cynthia Kaiser, former FBI cyber deputy director, and Allan Liska, threat intelligence analyst at Recorded Future, report a 20-40% spike in ransomware incidents this summer, totaling nearly 3,000 cases. AI is being integrated into attack chains to enhance phishing efficacy and negotiation, with groups like Gentlemen, Qilin, and Akira leveraging LLMs to optimize operations.

title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
title_en: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
author: Matthias Bastian
content_snippet:
OpenAI is apparently disbanding its robotics team again, but this time for different reasons than in 2020.

Rather than abandoning robotics, the company wants to accelerate it by folding researchers into other teams. Robotics researchers are moving to the main research team under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen, while the applied robotics and hardware teams join Greg Brockman's Applied organization.

OpenAI made the decision on such short notice that it had already booked a booth at the Confere
summary_en: OpenAI is dissolving its dedicated robotics division, reassigning researchers to the main research team under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen and the Applied organization led by Greg Brockman. The shift reflects a strategic pivot towards using general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra, which have outperformed specialized robotics models in spatial reasoning and task execution, for embodied AI development.

summary_zh: OpenAI重组机器人部门，将研发人员并入通用模型团队，旨在通过GPT-6 Astra等通用大模型直接驱动机器人执行任务

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI决定解散专门的机器人研发部门，将相关人员并入首席研究官Mark Chen领导的核心研究团队及Greg Brockman领导的应用部门。此举缘于OpenAI内部验证发现，基于通用模型架构的GPT-6 Astra在空间理解与任务执行力上已显著超越垂直领域的专用机器人模型，该公司正战略性地放弃“专用算法”路线，转而寻求通过多模态通用大模型实现具身智能。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI is dissolving its dedicated robotics division, reassigning researchers to the main research team under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen and the Applied organization led by Greg Brockman. The shift reflects a strategic pivot towards using general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra, which have outperformed specialized robotics models in spatial reasoning and task execution, for embodied AI development.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI首席研究官Mark Chen、总裁Greg Brockman及机器人研究团队在OpenAI内部组织架构重组：解散独立机器人研发部门，人员分流至通用模型与应用研究组
【起因与机理】验证结果表明通用模型在机器人控制任务上的表现优于专用模型，旨在通过大模型解决具身智能
【关键数据与实测】技术逻辑：GPT-6 Astra在模拟环境中的机器人任务成功率达74.8%，远超专用模型。
【各方立场与态度】战略演进：放弃专用机器人模型训练路径，转向由大模型直接驱动具身智能控制。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] OpenAI Chief Research Officer Mark Chen, President Greg Brockman, and the robotics team: Dissolution of dedicated robotics team and reassignment of researchers to general research and applied groups
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Validation shows general-purpose models outperform specialized ones in robotics tasks, aiming for AGI-led embodied intelligence
[Key Metrics] Technical performance: GPT-6 Astra achieved 74.8% success rate in simulated robotics tasks, outperforming specialized baselines.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic shift: Abandoning specialized model training in favor of general-purpose model-driven embodied control.

Coxon says a slide Anthropic released for its IPO roadshow was a key reason he left the company after only about four months. The chart shows how much compute Anthropic needs over time to train its models, and the axis is compressed so that a 10x and a 100x increase barely look different.

summary_en: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon revealed that the compute trajectory disclosed in the company's IPO roadshow indicates a significant jump in training efficiency for its Mythos model. He argues that algorithmic improvements are scaling super-exponentially, noting that Mythos can now be retrained with a fraction of its original compute requirement, with such gains trending toward automation.

Tendrils 坚信，基于其被称为“交互网络”（Interaction Nets）计算模型打造的通用处理器，能够彻底摆脱现有 CPU 架构所固有的大规模扩展成本困境与历史设计缺陷。
其核心硬件设计允许芯片内部并发调度执行数以千计的微型指令进程，从容承载极度复杂的并行计算负载。
在阐述其突破性路线时，Tendrils 官方表示：“我们并没有遵循传统的串行时钟顺序执行范式，而是直接将处理器设计为拥有数千个核心真正并行运转的拓扑结构。这要求硬件彻底跳出共享可变内存与线性指令序列的传统概念。为了让这一架构落地，我们同步联合研发了开源并行编程语言 Vine，该语言从第一行代码起即专为新一代‘并行优先’计算硬件量身定制。”
该初创公司目前尚未公开具体的芯片硬件测试跑分数据，但在架构理论上已展现出对异构并发工作流的颠覆性效能。

title: Anthropic's IPO is six times oversubscribed and on track to become the largest public offering in history
